description: This file defines enums, data models, and configuration structures related to services in the litellm project, including service types, metrics, configurations, and logging payloads.

classes.name: ServiceMetrics
classes.description: Enumeration of different metric types (counter, histogram, gauge) used for services.

classes.name: ServiceTypes
classes.description: Enumeration of service identifiers, including database, cache, operational queues, and other service components.

classes.name: ServiceConfig
classes.description: TypedDict defining configuration for services and their associated metrics.

classes.name: ServiceEventMetadata
classes.description: TypedDict for optional metadata logged during service success or failure events.

classes.name: ServiceLoggerPayload
classes.description: Pydantic model representing the payload logged during service operations, including error status, service type, duration, call type, and optional metadata.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Converts the ServiceLoggerPayload instance to JSON, handling exceptions for different pydantic versions.
